scope: Read-only audit of the frozen AM-TNC derivation, exact 4090 training sources and target-blind method state. This does not use intermediate quality to control training and is not an e200 benefit claim.

formula_to_code.claim: For two player-conditional views, form m=(g1+g2)/2 and d=(g1-g2)/2 in the frozen pre-step Adam diagonal A.
formula_to_code.implementation: _commit_player freezes _adam_scales before either gradient is committed; adam_metric_tangential_gradient constructs means and half-differences and computes all A-space energies in float64 reductions.

formula_to_code.claim: Remove only disagreement parallel to consensus and retain the Adam-metric tangential component.
formula_to_code.implementation: The committed estimator is mean+difference-(<Am,Ad>/||Am||^2)*mean. The reported radial and tangential energies use the same metric and exact orthogonal decomposition.

formula_to_code.claim: Exchange symmetry makes the estimator conditionally unbiased even though the later Adam map is nonlinear.
formula_to_code.implementation: Swapping ordered views preserves mean and negates difference and the projection coefficient; the residual around mean is odd. Equal views return the first tuple byte-exactly, and zero consensus returns the ordered first draw.

formula_to_code.claim: D and E use the shared pre-opponent bundle; G/F get a fresh bundle only after D/E commit.
formula_to_code.implementation: The enforced schedule is DE_BUNDLE,D_COMMIT,E_COMMIT,GF_BUNDLE,GF_COMMIT. Every update checks this exact tuple and fails closed on deviation.

formula_to_code.claim: Native optimizer structure, endpoint law and paired-target access remain unchanged.
formula_to_code.implementation: Each player calls its existing optimizer once after assigning the derived gradient; G uses the native generator hooks and F native step. The algorithm reads current unpaired forward/loss views and previous Adam second moments only.

formula_to_code.claim: The full schedule and counters are resumable and one-replica mode is exact native identity.
formula_to_code.implementation: replicates=1 delegates the complete native optimize_parameters. Active checkpoints bind replica count, update index, both bundle counts, last schedule and last geometry; a changed schedule or replica count fails closed.

configuration_boundary.normalization: instance for G/D/E under the frozen common profile
configuration_boundary.meaning: The two sequential views do not acquire BatchNorm running-state asymmetry under the frozen scientific configuration; the exchangeability claim is configuration-bound rather than universal to arbitrary networks with mutable forward buffers.
configuration_boundary.expected_adam_scale: raw pre-step exp_avg_sq without bias correction, exactly as declared in the derivation card

target_blind_execution_snapshot.interpretation: The implementation is preserving almost all instantaneous disagreement tangent at this fixed state, as designed. It is consequently close to—but not identical with—the ordered first-replica proposal here; the mandatory proposal-only e200 ablation is what can attribute any final result.

remaining_scientific_question: Only the fixed complete e200 matched trajectory and subsequent full/proposal-only/observable-only ablations can decide sustained benefit and component attribution.
